business: MA Transport (cloud transport management software for Australian bus and coach operators)
target: Owner-managers of independent Australian bus, coach and charter businesses running about 3 to 30 vehicles (charter, school excursions, corporate, weddings, shuttles), mostly in NSW, VIC and QLD

segments.name: Owner of a small charter/shuttle business with 3-5 vehicles (would be on the A$199 Starter plan)
Owner-manager of a 6-15 vehicle coach and charter business (would be on the A$399 Growth plan)
Managing director of a 16-30 vehicle family coach company (would be on the A$699 Fleet plan)

behaviours.name: Spreadsheet and whiteboard loyalist
behaviours.how: Runs bookings, rosters and invoices in Excel, a whiteboard and Xero; has never paid for operations software.

behaviours.name: Locked in to an existing system
behaviours.how: Already pays for a charter or dispatch package (such as Coach Manager or eCoachManager) and dreads moving years of data.

behaviours.name: Asks other operators first
behaviours.how: Will not buy anything until a peer at the bus association or a nearby operator vouches for it.

behaviours.name: Cost-cutter
behaviours.how: Watches every monthly subscription; fuel, insurance and wages already squeeze the margin.

behaviours.name: Growth-minded operator
behaviours.how: Adding vehicles and contracts, feels the admin outgrowing the current setup, open to new tools.

behaviours.name: Compliance worrier
behaviours.how: Had a stressful accreditation audit or incident and wants records that would stand up to scrutiny.

objections: I already have something that works well enough
Moving all my bookings, drivers and vehicle history across sounds like a nightmare in peak season
Is this a brand-new company that might disappear and take my data with it?
My drivers are not tech people; they won't use another app
Coach Manager or my telematics already does half of this for less
That's a lot per month on top of everything else I pay for
Will it actually handle charter quoting and Australian accreditation, or is it generic?
I don't have time to learn new software
habits: you take booking calls yourself while also driving a run some days
school excursion and end-of-year event season is your busiest time
your office manager does the invoicing in Xero on Fridays
you go to the state bus association's regional meetings once or twice a year
your vehicles already have GPS trackers from a telematics provider
a double-booking last year cost you a regular client
